claims_supported: Arc mainnet launched September 16, 2026 with 11 founding validators and 100+ apps.

Circle reports $1.5B assets on Arc, $30B+ USDC volume since mainnet launch, approximately $1B per day over the prior week, approximately 500,000 transactions per day and 50M+ transactions since launch, as of October 30, 2026.
Circle reports Q3 CPN annualized TPV of $41.3B and 205 financial institutions enrolled; TPV uses the trailing 30 days as of quarter end.
Circle describes Arc as CPN's preferred settlement layer and says Coinbase is live on Arc through its exchange and wallets.
Circle's presentation cites Artemis for a 99.6% USDC share of x402 payment volume as of October 25, 2026; this is not all agent payments or CPN volume.

limitations: Rounded issuer-presented total; not all assets are USDC.
Asset value is not net new capital, XRP collateral or XRP spot demand.
Components sum to approximately $1.52B while the slide rounds total assets to $1.5B; preserve rounding rather than force reconciliation.
Gross transfer volume is not net issuance, unique counterparties, external economic payments, net new capital or XRP demand.
Circle cites Arc RPC, CoinGecko, DefiLlama, Registrai, Dune and company data; the underlying raw datasets were not independently captured.
Approximate issuer-presentation figure; period endpoints and transaction classification were not independently reconciled.
Transaction count is not payment count, unique users, economic settlement or capital flow.
Cumulative transaction count; no transaction-type or unique-counterparty decomposition was captured.
Circle defines TPV from the trailing 30 days at quarter end and annualizes it; it is not realized Q3 settlement, net capital or XRP-related volume.
Enrollment count includes customers enrolled since CPN launch across several product categories; it does not prove active monthly transactors or settled volume.
Circle's presentation cites Artemis; the underlying Artemis dataset was not independently retrieved.
x402 payment volume is not all AI-agent payments, not Circle Payments Network TPV and not XRP settlement volume.
Endpoint listings are not active agents, payment transactions, unique customers or revenue.
Roadmap target only; never treat as measured current throughput.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Arc plus CPN could substitute for XRP bridge liquidity in corridors where counterparties can settle end-to-end in USDC.
support: Circle describes Arc as CPN's preferred settlement layer.
Circle reports growing Arc USDC activity and $41.3B annualized CPN TPV.
disconfirming_or_missing: No corridor-level evidence of former XRP routes switching to Arc.
No synchronized XRP bridge-volume, spread or counterparty data.
USDC settlement only solves routes where counterparties can hold and redeem USDC.
tests: Compare matched corridors before/after Arc/CPN adoption.
Measure XRP bridge legs, USDC balances, settlement cost, latency and net capital by route.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Circle's Arc expansion may complement rather than displace XRPL because USDC is also native on XRPL and Coinbase supports multiple stablecoin/network combinations.
support: Coinbase's RLUSD distribution on XRPL, Base and Ethereum plus its reported Arc integration.
disconfirming_or_missing: No route-level transaction graph showing cross-network liquidity reuse.
No evidence that Arc and XRPL flows are coordinated.
tests: Track issuer mint/burn and bridge flows by chain.
Measure whether Arc activity coincides with rising or falling XRPL USDC and XRP bridge usage.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Arc's reported cumulative and daily volume may materially exceed unique external economic settlement because gross on-chain transfers can include repeated, internal or protocol-driven movements.
support: Circle reports gross USDC on-chain volume and transaction counts, not net new capital or unique counterparties.
disconfirming_or_missing: Circle cites multiple underlying data providers, but raw datasets and transaction classifications were not independently reproduced.
tests: Capture Arc RPC ledger receipts and transaction hashes.
Classify exchange, bridge, issuer, protocol, treasury and user transfers; compute unique counterparties and net flows.

competing_hypotheses.claim: CPN's $41.3B annualized TPV overstates realized quarterly payment value if interpreted as actual Q3 settlement.
support: Circle defines TPV from the trailing 30 days at quarter-end and annualizes it.
disconfirming_or_missing: No independently captured daily CPN settlement series or quarterly realized total.
tests: Obtain CPN daily transaction and settlement reports; reconcile with bank payouts and net settlement.

competing_hypotheses.claim: USDC's reported share of x402 payment volume may give Circle an early distribution advantage in agentic payments, but it does not establish an XRP exclusion or durable moat.
support: Circle cites Artemis for 99.6% of x402 payment volume settling in USDC as of 2026-10-25.
Circle lists approximately 2,800 agent endpoints as of 2026-10-25.
disconfirming_or_missing: The x402 universe may be narrow and early-stage.
No independently captured payment counts, economic value, repeat usage or competing-asset breakdown.
tests: Retrieve Artemis x402 raw data and methodology.
Measure unique agents, settled value, repeat rate, fees and asset/network alternatives.

explicit_disconfirming_evidence: USDC is also natively available on XRPL; Arc activity alone does not prove XRP displacement.
Coinbase's RLUSD distribution across XRPL, Base and Ethereum is consistent with a multi-asset, multi-chain strategy.
No XRP purchase, XRP collateral or XRP bridge flow is disclosed in the cited Circle presentation.
Gross transfer volume, assets on network, transaction counts, enrolled institutions and annualized TPV are different measures and must not be added or treated as actual capital.
The 100K+ TPS figure is a roadmap target, not measured throughput.
The 99.6% x402 figure is limited to x402 payment volume and is attributed to Artemis by Circle; it is not all agent payments or CPN volume.
Circle's cited underlying Arc data sources were not independently retrieved in this capture; source independence is not established.

data_quality.source_independence: one primary issuer presentation; no independent raw-source corroboration in this artifact
data_quality.timestamp_quality: presentation date is 2026-11-04; Arc metrics as of 2026-10-30, CPN quarter-end 2026-09-30, x402/agent endpoints as of 2026-10-25
scope_controls: Do not combine Arc assets, gross transfer volume, transactions/day, CPN annualized TPV, x402 volume share or agent endpoint count.
Do not interpret gross transfer volume as net new capital.
Do not interpret CPN annualized TPV as quarterly realized settlement.
Do not treat Coinbase's Arc integration as XRP usage.
Do not treat Circle's Arc as XRPL.

prediction_status.reason: These issuer-presented network metrics are not a synchronized XRP market feature set and have no raw-byte receipts, independent corroboration or validated predictive relationship.

next_actions: Capture Arc RPC block and transaction data with exact ledger/block hashes, raw response bodies, retrieval times and independent SHA-256 receipts.
Reconstruct Arc USDC gross and net flows, unique counterparties, exchange/bridge/issuer/protocol activity and economic-payment classifications.
Verify Arc assets and transaction counts independently against Arc RPC, Dune and other named providers; do not treat the Circle presentation as independent corroboration.
Obtain CPN daily realized settlement series and distinguish trailing-30-day annualized TPV from actual quarter volume.
Retrieve Artemis x402 methodology and raw observations before using the 99.6% share in any model.
Measure Coinbase's exact Arc products/assets and compare with its RLUSD distribution on XRPL/Base/Ethereum.
Test whether Arc/CPN flows substitute for or complement XRP bridge legs in matched corridors; retain both hypotheses until transaction evidence resolves them.
Do not issue a directional XRP forecast until synchronized spot/depth/derivatives and historical feature data pass walk-forward, baseline, calibration and drift checks.
